verses.en: I made a covenant with mine eyes; why then should I think upon a maid?
verses.sm: Iopu Ua ou osia le feagaiga ma oʻu mata, se a foi le mea ou te manatu ai i se taupou?

verses.en: For what portion of God is there from above? and what inheritance of the Almighty from on high?
verses.sm: Se a foi le tofi mai le Atua o i luga? ma le tofi mai Le e ona le malosi uma lava o i mea maualuluga?

verses.en: Is not destruction to the wicked? and a strange punishment to the workers of iniquity?
verses.sm: E le ua tuu ca le malaia mo le ua amio leaga, ma le puapuaga mo e ua fai mea leaga?

verses.en: Doth not he see my ways, and count all my steps?
verses.sm: Ua le silasila ea o ia i oʻu ala, ma faitaulia oʻu laasaga uma?

verses.en: If I have walked with vanity, or if my foot hath hasted to deceit;
verses.sm: Afai ua ou savali ma le pepelo, po ua tele vavave oʻu vae i le faa'ole'ole,

verses.en: Let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know mine integrity.
verses.sm: ia fuatia aʻu e ia i le fua faatautau tusa, ia silafia ai e le Atua ua sao laʻu amio.

verses.en: If my step hath turned out of the way, and mine heart walked after mine eyes, and if any blot hath cleaved to mine hands;
verses.sm: Afai ua o ese oʻu vae i le ala, ma mulimul: atu loʻu loto i oʻu mata, ma pipii mai se mea leaga i oʻu lima;

verses.en: Then let me sow, and let another eat; yea, let my offspring be rooted out.
verses.sm: ia ou luluina atu saito, a ia “aina e se tasi; ia liaiina foi aʻu mea e tutupu.

verses.en: If mine heart have been deceived by a woman, or if I have laid wait at my neighbour's door;
verses.sm: Afai ua olegia loʻu loto i se fafine, po ua ou lamalama i le faitotoa o lē ma te tuaoi;

verses.en: Then let my wife grind unto another, and let others bow down upon her.
verses.sm: ia olo ai saito e laʻu avā ma se tasi, ia taooto foi ma ia isi tane.

verses.en: For this is an heinous crime; yea, it is an iniquity to be punished by the judges.
verses.sm: Auā o le agasala tele lea, o le pagota foi lea e faasalaina e faamasino.

verses.en: For it is a fire that consumeth to destruction, and would root out all mine increase.
verses.sm: Auā o le afi lava lea e susunuina ai seia oo ina faaumatia; e liaiina ai foi aku mea uma ua tutupu.

verses.en: If I did despise the cause of my manservant or of my maidservant, when they contended with me;
verses.sm: Afai ana ou le mafai ona faamasinoina mea a laʻu auauna tane ma laʻu auauna fafine, ina ua la finau mai ia te au;

verses.en: What then shall I do when God riseth up? and when he visiteth, what shall I answer him?
verses.sm: se a foi se mea ou te faia pe a tulai mai le Atua? Se a foi sa'u e tali atu ai ia te ia pe a faamasino mai o ia?

verses.en: Did not he that made me in the womb make him? and did not one fashion us in the womb?
verses.sm: O lē na faia aʻu i le manava, e le o ia foi lea na faia o ia? E le o le toatasi ea foi na ia faia i maua i le manava?

verses.en: If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail;
verses.sm: Afai ua ou taofi se mea na mananao i ai o e matitiva, po ua fole talu aʻu, mata o le fafine ua oti lana tane;

verses.en: Or have eaten my morsel myself alone, and the fatherless hath not eaten thereof;
verses.sm: po ua ou ʻai toatasi na o aʻu i laʻu mea e “ai, a e lei “ai ai foi le ua aumatua.

verses.en: (For from my youth he was brought up with me, as with a father, and I have guided her from my mother's womb;)
verses.sm: Auā na ma tutupu talu ina ou itiiti, e peiseai o lona tamā aʻu; talu foi ina fanaua mai aʻu e loʻu tinā, ua ou tausi i le fafine ua oti lana tane.

verses.en: If I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or any poor without covering;
verses.sm: Afai ua ou iloa se tasi a fano ina ua leai sona ofu, ma se ua mativa ua leai sona lavalava;

verses.en: If his loins have not blessed me, and if he were not warmed with the fleece of my sheep;
verses.sm: afai ua le faamanū mai ia te au lona sulugatiti, afai foi ua le mafanafana o ia i fulufulu o aʻu mamoe;

verses.en: If I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, when I saw my help in the gate:
verses.sm: afai ua ou sii atu loʻu lima i le ua aumatuā, ina ua ou iloa i le faitotoa le fesoasoani ia te au;

verses.en: Then let mine arm fall from my shoulder blade, and mine arm be broken from the bone.
verses.sm: ia paú ese ai loʻu tau'au i le ivisa, ia faʻia foi loʻu lima ai le tulilima.

verses.en: For destruction from God was a terror to me, and by reason of his highness I could not endure.
verses.sm: Auā ua ia te au le mataʻu i le malaia mai le Atua; ua ou le mafaia foi ona o lona silisili..

verses.en: If I have made gold my hope, or have said to the fine gold, Thou art my confidence;
verses.sm: Afai ua ou fai auro ma mea ou te faalagolago i ai, po ua ou fai atu i auro, O loʻu faatuatuaga oe;

verses.en: If I rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because mine hand had gotten much;
verses.sm: afai ua ou olioli ina ua tele loʻu oloa, ina ua.maua foi e o'u lima mea e tele,

verses.en: If I beheld the sun when it shined, or the moon walking in brightness;
verses.sm: afai ua ou vaai i le la ina ua pupula mai; ma le masina ina ua alualu ac, ma susulu mai;

verses.en: And my heart hath been secretly enticed, or my mouth hath kissed my hand:
verses.sm: ma ua olegia faalilolilo loʻu loto, ma ua miti ai loʻu gutu i loʻu lima;

verses.en: This also were an iniquity to be punished by the judge: for I should have denied the God that is above.
verses.sm: o le agasala lava lea e faasalaina e faamasino; aua o le tuua lea e aʻu o le Atua o i lugā.

verses.en: If I rejoiced at the destruction of him that hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him:
verses.sm: Afai ua ou olioli i le malaia o le ua ʻinoʻino mai ia te au, ma ou faatuumana ina ua maua o ia i le leaga;

verses.en: Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin by wishing a curse to his soul.
verses.sm: ua ou le mafaia foi ona agasala loʻu gutu i le ole atu ia faafanoina o ia.

verses.en: If the men of my tabernacle said not, Oh that we had of his flesh! we cannot be satisfied.
verses.sm: Ua le fai ane ea o loʻu au aiga, O ai ea ua le maʻona i ana manu?

verses.en: The stranger did not lodge in the street: but I opened my doors to the traveller.
verses.sm: E lei moe i fafo le tagata ese; ua ou faaavanoa loʻu faitotoa ma malaga.

verses.en: If I covered my transgressions as Adam, by hiding mine iniquity in my bosom:
verses.sm: Afai ua ou ufiufi loʻu solitulafono e pei o Atamu, i loʻu natia o laʻu agasala i loʻu loto,

verses.en: Did I fear a great multitude, or did the contempt of families terrify me, that I kept silence, and went not out of the door?
verses.sm: ia ou fefe lava i le vao tagata e toatele; ia faaatuatuvaleina aʻu i le ʻinoʻino mai o aiga; ia ou faalologo foi, ia ou le toe ulufafo i le faitotoa.

verses.en: Oh that one would hear me! behold, my desire is, that the Almighty would answer me, and that mine adversary had written a book.
verses.sm: E! fia faafofogaina mai aʻu e ia. Faauta, o loʻu faailoga; ia tali mai Le e ona le malosi uma lava ia te au, ma ia tusia se tusi e le tagata ua finau mai ia te au.

verses.en: Surely I would take it upon my shoulder, and bind it as a crown to me.
verses.sm: Ou te faafuataina lava; ou te nonoaina lava e fai moʻu pale.

verses.en: I would declare unto him the number of my steps; as a prince would I go near unto him.
verses.sm: Ou te faaali atu ia te ia le faitau o oʻu laasaga; ou te faalatalata atu ia te ia e pei o se alii sili.

verses.en: If my land cry against me, or that the furrows likewise thereof complain;
verses.sm: Afai e alaga atu loʻu fanua ona o aʻu, ma fetagisi faatasi ona atu pue;

verses.en: If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money, or have caused the owners thereof to lose their life:
verses.sm: afai ua ou ‘aina ona fua ma le le tauia, ma ou faasaunoa i e pule i ai,

verses.en: Let thistles grow instead of wheat, and cockle instead of barley. The words of Job are ended.
verses.sm: ia tupu mai ai le laau talatala e sui aʻi le saito, ma le vao leaga e sui aʻi le karite!
